headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their winning streak, dominating the Tampa Bay Rays in a 10-0 shutout loss. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In another matchup, the Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics due to right knee chondromalacia. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks with a right adductor strain. Other notable injuries include Jeff Criswell's right shoulder strain with the Colorado Rockies and Sal Frelick's right shoulder strain with the Milwaukee Brewers.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades and player transactions. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals received RHP Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays in a trade. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired CF Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers traded for RHP Lance McCullers Jr. and LHP Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with 2 hits and 2 home runs, while Aroldis Chapman earned the save with 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Yankees 2-1 in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run in the game. Muncy's 18th homer of the season came on a fly ball to right field, scoring Mookie Betts and propelling the Dodgers to the win.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers in a lopsided 15-1 victory. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers with 3 hits, including a home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Cleveland Guardians in a decisive 7-1 victory, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Bryan Reynolds, while Brandon Lowe and Steven Kwan stood out for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 6-2 victory. Taj Bradley led the Cubs' pitching effort, while Seiya Suzuki and Nico Hoerner contributed to the winning offense.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Placed on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee chondromalacia. The injury occurred on July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire Aiden Moffett in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for RHP Aiden Moffett.
